# expat / xml_parse_fuzzer_UTF-8

expat's own fuzz target `xml_parse_fuzzer_UTF-8` ([source](source/xml_parse_fuzzer.c), modified; see below), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libexpat 2.7.5 (libexpat/libexpat at f31adfd5).

Runs the input through four parsers (plain for ENCODING_FOR_FUZZING, namespace-aware, external-entity "e1", external DTD), each XML_Parse non-final then final, with a hash salt derived from siphash of the input; status, error string and line number are discarded; odd sizes also exercise XML_ParserReset.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libexpat 2.7.5 at commit f31adfd5 with 1 patch to the library (listed on the project page).
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.
- The harness source differs from the upstream file at the pinned commit; the copy in source/ is the file as built.

## What the harness checks
- assert(size <= INT_MAX): a precondition on the input length before the int cast, not a property of the library; libFuzzer inputs never reach INT_MAX ([line 76](source/xml_parse_fuzzer.c#L76)): assert(); confirmed in the binary.

A failed check marked as ending the process contradicts every halts statement below, so a proof of one implies it on every input it covers.

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
